description: Internal and private fields use camelCase after their applicable field prefix.
label: stated
quote: 3. We use `_camelCase` for internal and private fields and use `readonly` where possible. Prefix internal and private instance fields with `_`, static fields with `s_` and thread static fields with `t_`. When used on static fields, `readonly` should come after `static` (e.g. `static readonly` not `readonly static`). Public fields should be used sparingly and should use PascalCasing with no prefix when used.
